messages.content: I’ll charge at the lower-priced hours, sell into the morning peak, and use idle battery capacity for reserves. I’ll then adjust energy dispatch as real-time prices and ERCOT notices arrive.
The morning sale and midday recharge are complete. The battery is at 125 MWh, with no reserve failures so far. I’m retaining the late-hour sale; it leaves the required 62.5 MWh at day-end.
